title: Headcount Retention and Technology Transfer for Citizen Workforce of Singapore-based AI Company Recently Acquired by Meta
what_it_is: Headcount Retention and Technology Transfer for Citizen Workforce of Singapore-based AI Company Recently Acquired by Meta

sections.label: MOM, EDB on foreign companies
sections.summary: MOM does not intervene in acquisition agreements, foreign companies must comply with manpower laws, and EDB facilitates skills transfer for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) does not intervene in such acquisition agreements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Government does not disclose details of the workforce demographics of individual companies in line with confidentiality obligations, and all foreign companies operating in Singapore are expected to comply with Singapore's manpower laws and fair hiring practices.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Economic Development Board (EDB) works closely with foreign companies and startups to facilitate skills transfer, training and capability development for the Singapore workforce, ensuring that Singaporeans benefit from the presence of such companies in our business environment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, EDB has rolled out initiatives such as the Enterprise Compute Initiative (ECI) to support skills transfer and capability development.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: ECI partners major cloud service providers such as Microsoft to help Singapore-based companies build dedicated local AI teams.

sections.label: Hiring practices for companies
sections.summary: New, redomiciled and existing companies are treated the same on hiring, and laws protect workers' rights in hiring or retrenchment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In general, we do not treat new, redomiciled or existing companies any differently in terms of hiring practices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Any arrangements that occur as a result of acquisition or restructuring is something that is a commercial arrangement between companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But we will make sure that when it comes to hiring or retrenchment, as we have discussed in an earlier Parliamentary Question, the laws will protect the rights of our workers and make sure that they are treated fairly and equitably.
